results.title: Extremely elevated lipoprotein(a) levels tied to 30-year heart risk in...
results.content: Elevated plasma lipoprotein(a) is a cardiovascular disease risk factor, with levels predominantly determined genetically and stabilizing within the first two years of life. Lifelong exposure follows from that timing, with baseline measurement positioned as a durable marker of future level.
